answerlines: boron [accept B before mention; accept element number 5 or equivalents before mention]

clues.text: Eleven atoms of this element, and eleven halides, are found in the strongest known single-molecule acid.
Organic compounds with this element burn with a bright green flame, and they can be easily converted into alcohols by treating them with basic hydrogen peroxide.
Its hydrides add in THF solution to alkenes and are oxidized by peroxides in a reaction named for Brown.
An atom of this element is bonded to nitrogen and oxygen in the CBS catalyst.
Diamond has been shown to be weaker than a nanotube containing this element bound to nitrogen.
An isotope of this element is bombarded with epithermal neutrons in neutron capture therapy, which aims to destroy cancerous tumors.
This element and gallium are used to dope silicon p-type.
Because this element only has three valence electrons, molecules such as its trifluoride are often electron deficient.
Glasses containing this element, like Pyrex, have low thermal expansion coefficients, making them ideal for withstanding thermal shock.
Identify this element with atomic number 5 and symbol B.
